answer_1.quote: Model builders can prompt an LLM with the domain of texts and labels of interest and the LLM can quickly generate text data for the model builder's needs.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text instances (e.g., movie reviews, news headlines, tweets, sentences) with accompanying labels

answer_2.quote: We also evaluated label accuracy... We measured the diversity of the dataset using Remote-Clique metric... We also measured the similarity of the generated dataset to the oracle dataset with the average mean pairwise distances.

answer_3.quote: For SST-2, we used GPT-3 few-shot classification as the evaluator, as it has higher accuracy than the oracle model.

answer_4.quote: We sampled 360 data instances for each task... an author served as the oracle and annotated if they were OOS or not.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators examined each generated instance and determined whether it was out-of-scope (OOS) or in-scope according to the task definition.
